threads.body: This gate blocks the documented `/breaking-change` and `/deprecation` path for external contributors. `CONTRIBUTING.md:14-16` and `CONTRIBUTING.md:31-33` specifically direct users who cannot apply labels themselves to post these commands, but those users normally have `NONE`, `CONTRIBUTOR`, or `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR` association and will no longer trigger this job. Preserve the prior all-PR-commenter behavior, or update the contributor guidance if these commands are intentionally becoming maintainer-only.
